learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about fun words that show us doing something, like jumping and playing!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Can you jump like a frog? Or fly like a bird? When you do these fun things, you are using action words!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that tell us what someone is doing are called action words. We also call them doing words. Every time your body moves, you are doing an action!
examples: The boy kicks the ball. (Kicks is the action!)
The baby cries. (Cries is the action!)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Animals also do actions just like us! Birds fly in the bright sky. Fish swim in the cool water. Monkeys climb tall trees.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is an action word?
❓ What action does a fish do in the water?

fun_activity.title: 🕺 The Action Freeze Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents to say an action word like dance or jump. You have to do that action super fast and freeze when they say stop!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Action words tell us what people or animals are doing.
⭐ Words like play, eat, jump, and sleep are all fun action words!
